title: performance_event
description: One timing measurement of the Console, for the Performance station (see PERFORMANCE_EVENT_GUIDE.md). Today only kind sign_in: how long a Console sign-in took, step by step, measured by the page of the person who signed in and sent through the record_timing op. Rules the schema cannot express: the person sending cannot choose who it is recorded for (the server stamps created_by and role_key); numbers are milliseconds, 0 to 600000; records are create-only (no edit, no delete through any door); only a person holding view_performance (a super admin has every capability) reads them; the Global Inspector reads them too (view only); no name, email or token is ever stored; one record per person per 10 seconds is kept (more are dropped quietly).
x_retention: Kept. Records are never edited. The station shows the last 90 days; permanent removal after that is a separate job (parking lot). (A written policy only.)

kind.description: What was measured. Today only sign_in. Required.

device.description: phone or desktop, worked out by the page from the screen width. Required.

method.description: How the person signed in: google or key (the admin key). Required.

total_ms.description: Milliseconds from the moment the sign-in was accepted by Google (or the key was sent) until the Console was ready to open. The cosmetic Liftoff pause is not counted. Required.

check_ms.description: Milliseconds the first call to the server took (asking who is signed in, or for a key, loading the first list), including any cold start. Optional.

load_ms.description: Milliseconds loading the first lists after that. Optional.

server_ms.description: Milliseconds the server itself spent on the who-am-I call, as the server measured it (so the rest of check_ms is the network and the wake-up). Optional.

cold.description: True when the server instance that answered had just woken up (it was the first request that instance handled). Optional.

role_key.description: The role of the person who signed in (for example manager). Set by the server, never by the sender.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
